EXPECTED RED on today's code at the epoch step: TurnBridge.onChatChanged (turnBridge.ts:160-164) resets and reloads on every CHAT_CHANGED, and the load bumps the owner epoch (loadStory -> invalidateRuns, runtimeManager.ts:547 and :78 -> RunOwner.bump, runOwner.ts:80-98), so in-flight reads and pending boundaries of this very chat are dropped. steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const row = ctx.chat[0]; if (!row?.is_user) throw new Error('message 0 is not the player line'); if (rt.getEngineState().blackboard.values.took_key !== true) throw new Error('took_key did not land'); const former = 'V24-02 Former Persona'; if (ctx.name1 === former) throw new Error('the active persona already carries the former name, so the sync would change nothing'); row.name = former; await ctx.saveChat(); globalThis.__v24Sync = { epoch: rt.getRunContext().sessionEpoch, chatId: ctx.chatId, name1: ctx.name1, former }; return globalThis.__v24Sync;

const ctx = () => SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; for (let i = 0; i < 100; i += 1) { if (ctx().chat?.[0]?.name === globalThis.__v24Sync.name1 && rt.getSnapshot().storyId) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (ctx().chatId !== globalThis.__v24Sync.chatId) throw new Error(`the sync moved the page to ${ctx().chatId}; H9 says it reloads the SAME chat`); if (ctx().chat?.[0]?.name !== globalThis.__v24Sync.name1) throw new Error(`/persona-sync did not rename the user row (H8): it is ${JSON.stringify(ctx().chat?.[0]?.name)}`); if (!rt.getSnapshot().storyId) throw new Error('the story is not loaded after the reload'); return { renamedTo: ctx().chat[0].name, chatId: ctx().chatId };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const now = rt.getRunContext().sessionEpoch; if (now !== globalThis.__v24Sync.epoch) throw new Error(`the same-chat reload behind /persona-sync was treated as a chat switch: the run epoch moved ${globalThis.__v24Sync.epoch} -> ${now}, so every in-flight read and pending boundary of this chat was dropped (plan 02 section 3)`); return { epoch: now };
